vendor: SEOMoz, Inc. (d/b/a Moz), a Ziff Davis company
product_family: SEO and digital-marketing software suite: Moz Pro (all-in-one SEO toolkit incl. keyword research, rank tracking, site crawl, AI-visibility tracking), Moz Local (local business listings management), STAT (enterprise SERP tracking/analytics), Moz API and Moz Data (licensed access to Moz's link/keyword index), plus free tools (MozBar, Domain Authority Checker, Link Explorer) and Moz Academy (SEO training courses - not a security certification).

certifications.name: SOC 2 (Type 1/2)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence found on the moz.com domain. A third-party vendor-risk aggregator (Nudge Security) lists Moz as 'SOC 2 Compliant' but cites no vendor source or audit report, and an independent scan (UpGuard) shows no certifications at all for moz.com.

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence found on the moz.com domain; no trust center, security page, or press release could be located confirming ISO 27001 certification.

certifications.name: GDPR (posture)
certifications.proof_quote: moz.com's own homepage displays an EU cookie/consent banner ('We and our 835 partners store and access personal data...') referencing 'our Privacy Policy', indicating GDPR-aware data practices, but specific GDPR compliance commitments (lawful basis, SCCs, DPO, data subject rights process) are not confirmed by a direct quote from the privacy policy.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of HIPAA compliance or Business Associate Agreement (BAA) offering found. Moz is a general SEO/marketing analytics tool, not built to process Protected Health Information (PHI); healthcare-SEO guidance sites note customers would need to confirm a BAA directly with Moz before using it on PHI-adjacent pages.

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence found on the moz.com domain of a PCI DSS attestation.

certifications.name: FedRAMP
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence found on the moz.com domain. A third-party aggregator (Nudge Security) lists Moz as 'FedRAMP Compliant' with no source; this is implausible for a consumer/agency SEO SaaS product with no public trust center.

certifications.name: CSA STAR
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence found on the moz.com domain. Same unverified third-party aggregator listing as FedRAMP above; not corroborated by any vendor-domain source.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 42001 (AI Governance)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of an AI-governance certification, despite Moz actively marketing 'AI Visibility' / brand-tracking-in-AI-search features.

certifications.name: CSA STAR AI
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence found on the moz.com domain.

privacy.ai_training_note: Moz markets an 'AI Visibility' feature that tracks a customer's brand presence in third-party AI answer engines (Google AI Mode, ChatGPT, Gemini); this is monitoring of external AI outputs, not evidence about whether Moz itself trains models on customer account data. No vendor-domain statement on this was found. A 'mozr.com/dpa' page surfaced in search results, but mozr.com is a separate, unrelated company, not Moz/moz.com.
privacy.data_region: n/a - hosting and data-residency regions are not confirmed on moz.com's privacy/legal pages

security.name: Trust center / public security documentation
security.value: None found; moz.com has no dedicated /security or /trust page.

security.name: Encryption in transit
security.value: not verified; moz.com serves over HTTPS but no vendor statement on TLS policy is published

security.name: Independent security scan rating
security.value: UpGuard's automated external-attack-surface scan rates moz.com 'A' (802/950), based on SSL/TLS and email-security configuration checks, not on any certified compliance framework

security.name: Corporate ownership / parent-company privacy program
security.value: Parent company Ziff Davis, LLC participates in the TRUSTe/TrustArc Data Privacy Framework verification program - this is an umbrella privacy-seal for Ziff Davis properties generally, not a Moz-specific SOC2/ISO27001 security attestation, and should not be presented as a Moz-held certification

products.name: Moz Pro
products.data_scope: Customer website/domain data, keyword and rank-tracking data, crawl data, account/billing info
products.notes: Core subscription product; tiered plans (Standard through Premium)

products.name: Moz Local
products.data_scope: Business listing details (name, address, phone, hours) pushed to Google, Facebook, and other directories; review data
products.notes: Manages PII-adjacent business location data across third-party directories

products.name: STAT
products.data_scope: Large-scale keyword/rank data, SERP feature tracking
products.notes: Positioned for enterprise SEO teams; likely higher data volume/scale than Moz Pro

products.name: Moz API / Moz Data
products.data_scope: Link index, keyword index, Domain/Page/Brand Authority metrics
products.notes: Usage governed by API terms; redistribution of proprietary data is restricted per terms found in search results

products.name: MozBar and free tools
products.category: Free browser extension / free SEO tools
products.data_scope: Pages the user browses (for MozBar), domains queried in free tools
products.notes: Consumer-facing free tier; likely lightest data footprint

compare.pricing_model: Tiered SaaS subscription (Moz Pro: Standard/Medium/Large/Premium) plus a free trial and free limited-use tools; STAT and Moz API/Data appear to be separately priced/enterprise-quoted

flags: A vendor-risk aggregator (Nudge Security) lists Moz as SOC 2, PCI, HIPAA, GDPR, ISO 27001, FedRAMP, and CSA STAR compliant with no sourcing, which conflicts with an independent UpGuard scan showing no certifications and with the absence of any public trust center.

Several unrelated 'Moz'-branded entities exist: Mozverse (a Web3/blockchain startup), MOZR (an unrelated SaaS company with its own DPA at mozr.com), and Mozzaz (a digital-health company that holds SOC 2). This report covers SEOMoz, Inc. (d/b/a Moz), a Ziff Davis company, per moz.com's own footer text.

Parent-vs-product cert ambiguity: Ziff Davis, LLC (Moz's corporate parent) holds a TRUSTe privacy-framework verification, but this is a corporate-umbrella privacy seal, not a Moz-product SOC2/ISO27001 attestation.
No HIPAA BAA evidence found; Moz should not be marketed to customers needing PHI-safe tooling without direct vendor confirmation.
